g.title: CRANK_VR
g.text: 60-2 missing tooth passive VR — MaxxECU VR input (N-1 trigger type)

OE# 3B0973703G — same connector body as CAM_HALL but DIFFERENT pinout. Crank: Signal+/Signal-/Shield (passive VR). Cam: +5V/GND/Signal (active Hall). LABEL PIGTAILS AT CRIMP TIME — swapped pigtails produce no-start with no obvious failure indicator. MTune: VR input, trigger N-1 / 60-2 pattern, same type as M52 crank. Only crank angle offset may differ — confirm in MTune Trigger Setup before first crank. ME7.1.1 harness ref: Conn B pin 82. Location: cylinder 5 side — sensor G28 "secured to the control housing cover" (timing chain compartment cover at cylinder 5 end). Source: charm.li CBTA/BGP component locations, item 12.

g.title: W_CRANK
g.text: Shielded twisted pair. Shield terminates at CMC E3 (GND Shield, pin 19) — dedicated shield ground, not sensor GND bus.

g.title: ECU_CMC
g.text: A1: GPO 5 (Rev light relay — Ph3 reassignment; ICV B freed)
B1: GPO 6 (FAN — CAN cmd → PMU16 O3)
C4: GPO 2 (Fuel pump — CAN cmd → PMU16 O4)

g.title: CAM_HALL
g.text: Hall effect, intake side top of head — +5V supply type (not +12V)

TODO: Confirm exact VW connector body type at install. ME7.1.1 harness ref: pin 86. +5V supply shared with MAP/TPS/PST-F1 (bulkhead pin 47). Signal → HOME input (CMC H4 = pin 32). Same bulkhead pin 25 as M52 cam.

g.title: W_CAM
g.text: +5V from shared sensor rail (CMC G1/pin 25 → AS79 pin 47). Shielded recommended — cam Hall signal runs in Sector 1 near crank trigger and coil primaries. Shield drain terminates at CMC E3 (GND Shield, pin 19). Float at sensor side.

g.title: CLT
g.text: NTC thermistor — cylinder 1 side, exhaust face of block

ME7.1.1 ref: pin 93. TODO: verify VW-specific 2-pin connector housing at engine. BGP source: the07k.wiki/upload/f/fd/BGP_Wiring_diagram.pdf (Diagram 4, "right rear"). Location: cylinder 1 side + exhaust side. In E36: front of engine, exhaust face. Route pigtail with heat sleeving (exhaust manifold adjacent).

g.title: IAT
g.text: NTC thermistor — airbox or intake pipe
Mount in intake pipe downstream of intercooler. TODO: confirm connector body at install.

g.title: MAP
g.text: Same sensor as M52 phase, upgrade to 3-bar if still on stock 1-bar. Route vacuum hose to BBG intake manifold (post-throttle body) for boost-corrected MAP.

g.title: DBW_TB
g.text: Stock ~65mm bore. Upgrade to VR6 03H133062 74mm for 600+ whp.

TODO: Confirm VW TB connector body and motor wire polarity at install. ME7.1.1 ref: Motor+=pin84, Motor-=pin92, TPS1=pin117, TPS2=pin118. MaxxECU ETh1 motor: C2 H4 (MOTOR 1+) → AS79 pin 22 → TB Motor+.
C2 H2 (MOTOR 1-) → AS79 pin 23 → TB Motor-.

NOT GPO3/GPO4. C2 MOTOR 1+/1- are the correct H-bridge outputs. Source: MaxxECU RACE GEN1 C2 pinout (maxxecu.com/webhelp/wirings-maxxecu_pinout.html). MTune: Settings → E-Throttle → Motor output → Motor 1. IMPORTANT: verify motor polarity with volt meter before wiring — swap Motor+/- at TB connector if throttle runs in wrong direction during e-throttle wizard. TPS1 → CMC G2 (pin 26) / AS79 pin 48 (was M52 TPS — same wire). TPS2 → CMC J2 (AIN 2, pin 34) / AS79 pin 56 (was ATF temp spare — repurposed). +5V → AS79 pin 47 (shared +5V rail, CMC G1). GND → AS79 pin 79 (SGND, CMC H1). Calibrate in MTune :: Throttle :: E-Throttle wizard.

g.title: W_DBW_MOTOR
g.text: ECU_C2:4:H4: MOTOR 1+ — ETh Motor+ → AS79 pin 22 → TB motor
ECU_C2:5:H2: MOTOR 1- — ETh Motor- → AS79 pin 23 → TB motor

22 AWG (size-22D contact accepts 22–26 AWG only; 3A peak, 0.5 m — 22 AWG adequate). Verify polarity at TB before final crimp. Engine-side wires terminate at throttle body motor leads (OE ref: pin 84 Mot+, pin 92 Mot-). Cabin side of this wire goes to MaxxECU C2 H4/H2 via AS79 pins 22/23.

g.title: ECU_C2
g.text: H4: MOTOR 1+ — ETh Motor+ → AS79 pin 22 → TB motor
H2: MOTOR 1- — ETh Motor- → AS79 pin 23 → TB motor

C2 H4 (MOTOR 1+) and C2 H2 (MOTOR 1-) are the dedicated H-bridge outputs for the 07K DBW throttle body. NOT GPO3/4. These wires cross the AS79 bulkhead via cabin pins 22 and 23 respectively. AIN 6 (C2 E4) and AIN 7 (C2 F1) are used for APS1/APS2 from the E46 pedal -- those are cabin-to-cabin wires and do not appear in engine-side connections here. Source: MaxxECU RACE GEN1 C2 pinout (maxxecu.com/webhelp/wirings-maxxecu_pinout.html). See maxxecu-m52.wv ECU_C2 for AIN 5 clutch wiring detail.

g.title: KNOCK_1
g.text: Bosch flat knock sensor 1-pin (M8 bolt mount)

GND via M8 mounting bolt to block — no separate GND wire. ME7.1.1 ref: pin 106. MaxxECU: CMC K3 (DIN/VR1, pin 39). AS79 bulkhead: signal via pin 43 (EXP: Knock sensor 1). Shield drain via pin 45. Location: "back side of engine block" = exhaust side (both KS1 and KS2). Source: charm.li CBTA/BGP component locations — "Knock Sensors" section.

g.title: W_KNOCK_1
g.text: GND via M8 mounting bolt — no GND wire. Shield drain (wire 2) terminates at CMC H1 (Sensor GND, pin 29) via AS79 pin 45. Float at sensor side. Per firewall-bulkhead.wv knock note. ROUTING: Both KS1/KS2 sensors are on the exhaust side of the block. Route pigtails down the block face, away from the exhaust manifold, then bundle into KNOCK sub-loom across the bottom of the engine. If any section runs within 100 mm (4 in) of exhaust manifold, wrap with DEI Reflect-A-Gold (p/n 010394, 1-1/2"x15' roll, $42.99 — designengineering.com/reflect-a-gold-heat-reflective-tape-1-5-x-15/) over the Techflex sleeve before tie-strapping. Reflect-A-Gold is a metalized polyimide laminated glass cloth, 800°F continuous (adhesive rated 325°F). NOT to be confused with Reflect-A-Cool (fiberglass foil sheet, 400°F).

g.title: KNOCK_2
g.text: Bosch flat knock sensor 1-pin (M8 bolt mount)
GND via M8 mounting bolt. ME7.1.1 ref: pin 107. MaxxECU: CMC K4 (DIN/VR2, pin 40). AS79 bulkhead: signal via pin 44. Shield drain via pin 45.

g.title: W_KNOCK_2
g.text: Shield drain terminates at CMC H1 (Sensor GND, pin 29) via AS79 pin 45 (shared with KS1). See W_KNOCK_1 for routing and heat management spec.

g.title: ECU_12PIN
g.text: MaxxECU M50 terminated harness — 12-pin power/chassis breakout
Coil/inj relay trigger (pin 2 — N/C, PMU16 O2)
Fuel pump relay trigger (pin 3 — N/C, PMU16 O4)
Coolant fan relay trigger (pin 9 — N/C, PMU16 O3)

g.title: W_VVT_SOL
g.text: 22 AWG (size-22D contact; 22 AWG adequate for solenoid drive current). Flyback diode at solenoid connector. Route in actuators sub-loom with boost solenoid.

g.title: INJ_1
g.text: MaxxECU M50 harness ships with EV1 connector ends — replace with EV14 pigtails for 07K. Product: http://injectordynamics.com/injectors/id1050-xds/

g.title: PST_F1
g.text: Dual oil temp+pressure — iABED M10x1.0 port on 07K oil housing
Same wiring as M52 phase — zero connector or cable changes. Mount: iABED 07K longitudinal oil housing M10x1.0 built-in port. Pressure → AIN 3 (0-5V, 0-10 bar). Temp → AIN 1 (NTC).

g.title: W_PST_F1
g.text: Same cable as M52 build — no change.

g.title: WIDEBAND
g.text: Same harness wiring as M52. Bung: weld 18mm x1.5 in 07K custom top-mount exhaust manifold, min 6in from collector, upstream of turbo. Sensor: Bosch 0 258 017 025 (LSU 4.9). Product: https://www.bosch-motorsport.com/products/sensors/lambda/lambda-sensor-lsu-4-9/

g.title: W_WBO2
g.text: Same wiring as M52. Heater+ (LSU 4.9 pin 5 / Hs+) splices to local +12V coil rail — see W_WBO2_HTR. Shielded — VS/VREF/IP/RCAL are low-level analog signals susceptible to injector/coil noise. Single-end drain at ECU end only. HEAT MANAGEMENT: Bung is on the custom top-mount exhaust manifold. Sleeve the first 300 mm (12 in) from the sensor body with DEI Fire Sleeve 3/8" ID (p/n 010470, 3/8"x36" kit, $26.99 — designengineering.com/fire-sleeve-tape-kit-0-375-id-x-36/; silicone-over-fiberglass, 500°F/260°C continuous, 2000°F intermittent). Transition to Techflex F6 after clearing the manifold/turbo heat zone. Route away from turbo turbine housing and wastegate — minimum 100 mm clearance. Tie-strap cable to manifold stud boss or block surface to prevent contact with hot metal under vibration.

g.title: W_WBO2_HTR
g.text: Splices to +12V coil/inj rail on engine side (ECU_12PIN[1]). Short stub — splice at rail, no ECU termination.

g.title: VVT_SOL
g.text: VW 07K intake cam VVT solenoid — connector TBD
2-pin. ME7.1.1 ref: cam actuator pin 115. MaxxECU GPO 3 (CMC D4 = pin 16).

07K intake cam VVT actuator solenoid. MaxxECU GPO 3 (CMC D4/pin 16) drives this. AS79 bulkhead: GPO 3 signal crosses via CABIN pin 35 (engine-side 07K plug pin 35). +12V from coil/inj relay (ECU_12PIN[1]). Flyback diode: 1N4007 at solenoid connector, cathode (banded end) to +12V pin, anode to GPO 3 pin. MTune: Settings → Outputs → GPO 3 → Function: PWM Solenoid → assign to Cam VVT control. Closed-loop cam timing target map: RPM vs load. TODO: Confirm VW 07K VVT solenoid connector body at install.
TTRS/CEPA intake cam VVT actuator is typically a 2-pin vertical-latch connector
on the intake cam cap at the cylinder-5 end of the head. Verify at engine.

g.title: BOOST_SOL
g.text: Same wiring as M52. GPO 1 (CMC B4/pin 8). +12V from coil/inj relay (ECU_12PIN[1]). Flyback diode: 1N4007 at connector, cathode (banded end) to +12V pin, anode to GPO 1 pin.

g.title: CLUTCH_POS_SENSOR
g.text: Rotary position sensor 0-5V — E36 clutch pedal pivot
Carries from Phase 1 M52 unchanged. Same pedal, same sensor, same C2 AIN 5.
No re-work required at 07K swap. See maxxecu-m52.wv CLUTCH_POS_SENSOR for full notes.

g.title: W_CLUTCH_POS
g.text: Unchanged from M52 phase. See maxxecu-m52.wv W_CLUTCH_POS for full notes.

g.title: ECU_16PIN
g.text: MaxxECU M50 terminated harness — 16-pin aux breakout
GPO 3 (VVT solenoid — via CMC D4 direct; ETh motor = C2 H4/H2, NOT GPO)
GPO 2 (Fuel pump — CAN cmd → PMU16 O4)

g.title: W_CAN
g.text: Twisted pair. 120ohm at far end if bus run over 1 m. Unchanged from M52 phase.

g.title: CAN_BUS_JUNCTION
g.text: MaxxECU CAN 1 (16-pin pins 9-10) feeds both the 8HP CAN harness and Gauge.S cluster. Bus speed: 500kbps. MaxxECU CAN 1 has built-in 120ohm terminator. Add 120ohm terminator at far end of bus if bus run over 1 meter total.

g.title: W_CAN_8HP
g.text: CAN junction → 8HP GEN1 harness. Unchanged from M52 phase.

g.title: W_CAN_GAUGES
g.text: CAN junction → Gauge.S cluster. Unchanged from M52 phase.

g.title: HP8_CAN
g.text: See harnesses/8hp-can.wv for full CAN + power wiring. Unchanged from M52 phase.

g.title: GAUGES_CAN
g.text: Gauge.S E36 PNP cluster CAN input
Gauge.S receives MaxxECU Default 1.3 CAN output (500kbps). Enable in MTune: CAN :: Default CAN output :: MaxxECU Default 1.3. Unchanged from M52 phase.

g.title: DCT_SHIFTER
g.text: DCT Shifter E36 (3-wire, no +12V supply needed)

Source: dctshifter.com/pages/installation — 3-wire only (no +12V). UP (Black) :: MaxxECU DIN 2 (Transmission UP shift). DOWN (Blue) :: MaxxECU DIN 1 (Transmission DOWN shift). GND (Brown) :: Sensor GND or chassis GND. MTune: Advanced :: 8HP :: Shifter type :: 8HP SEQ shifter. Cabin-to-cabin; does NOT cross firewall bulkhead. Unchanged from M52 phase.

g.title: W_SHIFTER
g.text: DCT Shifter paddle harness. Unchanged from M52 phase.

g.title: FLEX_FUEL
g.text: Flex fuel composition sensor — retain from M52, unchanged

GM 13577429 / Continental SE1004S. Pin A=+12V (system voltage — NOT 5V), Pin B=GND, Pin C=signal. Signal encodes ethanol % (frequency) and fuel temperature (pulse width) on one wire. Inline on fuel feed — position unchanged from M52. Zero wiring changes at Phase 3. +12V from coil/inj relay (ECU_12PIN[1]) — see connection block for correct routing.

g.title: W_FLEXFUEL
g.text: Retain flex fuel sensor if present. Unchanged from M52 phase.
